newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected militants kill farmer in south Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected militants kill farmer in south Egypt.

text.p: Gunmen thought to be Islamist militants shot and killed a farmer in southern Egypt on Sunday, security sources said.
Samir Munir Wassef, 40, was working in his sugarcane fields near the village of Mantout, about 260 km (160 miles) south of Cairo, when the gunmen opened fire. They then escaped.
Police suspect the Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), the largest organisation fighting to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state, the sources said.
The sources gave no motive but the Gama'a often kills civilians it believes to be police informers.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in political violence in Egypt since the Gama'a started fighting in 1992.
